Episode 228. The Battle of Groshay Castle (9)
Inside Groshay Castle.
The demons were constantly reporting the situation to Sakiel. Sakiel was in the strategy room, checking the dozens of crystal balls placed there and sending reinforcements to each defense line.

"Sakiel, ma'am! The right first line of defense has completely collapsed. Led by the White Wall, Luntia Runcandel and the owner of the sacred bow, as well as the fleet of Zipfel, are continuing to advance!"
"Your report is late, they are already attacking the second line of defense. Move faster and send the 13th army over there."
"Understood!"

"From the front, the army of Jin Runcandel has started to breach the third line of defense. Most of the forts have been incapacitated, and the Demon King Millieus Kitarin, who tried to stop them, has been killed."

"The complete recall of the Kitarin family just finished. Open the dimensional gate, tell them to immediately support the third line of defense at the front. As the entire family is going, they should be able to buy us a bit more time than Millieus."

"After breaking through the first line of defense at the rear, Zipfel's advancing speed has slowed down somewhat. Their fleet has been dispersed, but it's also being replenished. Once the regrouping is done, we expect the speed to increase again."
"The situation on the left is similar, but Orgal has yet to reveal himself."
Despite her calm expression, Sakiel felt stifled, as if she was going crazy.
The defense line was collapsing faster than expected.
'At this rate, ten days at most. No... Maybe we won't even last a week.'
Of course, the current situation was far from what Sakiel had hoped for.
Sakiel had received from Zito the authority to handle the invasion of the demons, and therefore, the success or failure obtained in the process would be hers.
To be precise, it would be her and Phaelito's. She could bear if she and Groshay were to be wronged, but she wanted to prevent Phaelito from being punished at all costs.
'The rate of death is much faster than the rate at which troops are being summoned. Moreover, the real Demon Kings are hardly being replenished.'

Summoning top-tier Demon Kings and a large number of troops was not something Sakiel could solve with her abilities. That was only possible for a very small number of Demon Kings, including Zito and Phaelito.
'...What on earth is Zito thinking? Even if Phaelito spares her physical body in the Holy Kingdom, she should be able to send more high-level troops and other Demon Kings.'
Despite her intentions to defend the demon world's main base, Groshay Castle, which is nothing less than a gate, is being sieged.

'Is she trying to hold back Viseps by keeping the main force in the main base? No, it can't be. No matter what power Viseps is hiding, it can't threaten Zito. They're just a bunch of runaway bugs trying to prolong their lives.'
She had already requested reinforcements from Zito several times, but no response had come.
Therefore, Sakiel had no choice but to solve this situation with the remaining forces and her abilities alone.
"Starting from now, I will prepare the grand magic."
"Sakiel, by grand magic, you mean…?"
"The Field of Loss."
The demons' pupils dilated. The Field of Loss was one of the most taboo magic among demons, which artificially reproduced the 'Cycle of Oblivion'.

As it's a forced reproduction, there are numerous side effects of this magic. Unlike the original Cycle of Oblivion, the Field of Loss didn't only erase memories, but also extinguished the authority and power of its targets.
Furthermore, it couldn't distinguish friends from foes, and the price to unfold the magic was also brutal.
"Sakiel, don't tell me you're thinking about self-destruction?"
"There seems to be no other way."
"Even if we use all the fallen soldiers and generals as sacrifices, it wouldn't be enough to unfold the Field of Loss."
"If I add myself and the genuine artifact of Zito that I possess, the sacrifices will be sufficient."
"We can't lose you, Sakiel. Rather we should…"

"If your abilities were as high as mine, that would be the case. But you should know that it's insufficient to just use you as sacrifices. There's no reason to grieve over a choice made for the sake of Zito and the whole Demon World."
The demons bowed their heads.
"When they arrive, I will use the Field of Loss, seal the entire Groshay Castle, and destroy the dimensional gate leading to the Demon World."
"But wouldn't that make it impossible for Zito to come here in the future?"

"No, even if I destroy it, Zito can currently form the next dimensional gate easily. If I can successfully strike the enemies through the Field of Loss, it would actually make it much easier for Zito to spread his influence."
If her plan succeeds, Sakiel will inflict irreparable damage on most of the enemy's forces.
'They don't know much about our Demon World's dark magic. So, they won't be able to prepare for the Field of Loss in advance. However… I'm worried about Zipfel's divine stone.'

The Demon World had already gathered information about the divine stone's ability to manipulate history. To Sakiel, the divine stone could be a tool that might use a superior ability to the Field of Loss.

'Even if the divine stone can neutralize the Field of Loss, Zipfel will have to pay a high price. If they could manipulate history without any cost, they would have already been the sole rulers of this world, not just the intruders.'
And she was also concerned about the presence of Jin.
'Jin Runcandel... Is it just a false alarm because of his achievements so far, or do I get a feeling that he might have something to withstand the Field of Loss?'

Of course, just like Zipfel, a price must be paid in that case as well. Even if Jin withstands the Field of Loss, he won't be able to protect others from suffering. Sakiel sorted out his thoughts in that way.
If they couldn't win anyway, this was the best plan.

"Tell all the demons guarding the defense line as of now to prohibit the use of sacrifices. All the dead will be used for the Field of Loss. And also retrieve all of Lord Zito's relics. They should also be used as sacrifices."
"Understood."
"We also need to confuse the enemies. We need to make them confused about the fact that we are being pushed."
"How should we do that?"

"The right defense line where Kinzelo is attacking, Zipfel's rear defense line. The battles going on in these two battlefields are more like actual battles compared to other places. Send out standby troops there. It's a counterattack."
It's hard to create confusion by sending troops to the front, which is virtually a one-sided slaughter by the top superhumans, or the right.

Unless they send demons like Phaelito, Ridolros, and Videluche, whoever they send will die quickly at the hands of the alliance's superhumans, including Jin and Luna. That's also a necessary thing, even if it can't be helped.

"As soon as the right and rear lines start to push back, the Vamel alliance guys have to pay attention. There's nothing more tiresome for them than our army breaking through Kinzelo and Zipfel's fleet and heading to Inse. It's been proven since the Transcendental Fracture. They are most cautious about collateral damage. It means we need to make the alliance hesitate, even for a moment, to help Kinzelo and Zipfel."
"Understood, Lord Sakiel. We'll prepare immediately."
"Send Druga to Kinzelo and Ragal to Zipfel. We can only hope that they die at the right time to become successful sacrifices."
Front 3rd defensive line.

The Vamel Alliance's superhumans were still easily breaking the defensive line. Even though Jin was only assisting in the battle of Murakan and the superhumans, the demons were being killed defenselessly.
'At this rate, we can easily break through the 3rd defensive line today. And after a day's repair, there should be no problem entering again.'
Jin carefully observed the battlefield.
The 3rd defensive line seemed to have even less critical force from the enemies than the previous 1st and 2nd. No demons of Ragal's level appeared, and no demons using Zito's flesh were seen.
{Jin.}
"Yes, Sister Luna."
{We will soon match your breakthrough speed. But it's strange, I thought stronger guys would appear as we move forward. The real tough guys are nowhere to be seen.}
"Is that also the case on the right? It's the same here."
"Hmm, could it be that they have realized that having many defense lines is meaningless and have gathered major forces towards the inner defense line or the castle?"
"It might be possible, we'll keep a close eye."
{If any more peculiarities arise, I'll communicate again.}
As soon as Luna finished the communication, a message came from the golden ship.
{Leader! We're getting reports that suddenly, powerful demons are appearing at the right and rear defense lines.}
"Do you mean on the side of Kinzelo and Zipfel, Peitel?"
{Yes. It seems that they have taken out the forces that should have been deployed on our side and sent them over there. So, unlike us, the battle seems to have become quite fierce.}
Jin felt a strange sense of unease.

'They seemed desperate to defend, but suddenly they are counterattacking...? Do they think they can break through Kinzelo and Zipfel and even advance into the hinterland? If they want to capture civilians by attacking the hinterland, it would be better to use the rift.'
The battlefield that the alliance was responsible for suddenly had fewer demon kings, and the use of flesh was gone. He also didn't see the demons trying to use sacrifices to do something.

'I'm not sure what it is, but it looks like Sakiel is preparing a secret move. Considering the fact that they're not using flesh and fallen soldiers, it's likely to be something that requires a large number of sacrifices.'
Then there can be only one reason why Sakiel tried to counterattack on the right and rear defense lines.
'They're hoping that we will be tied up supporting Kinzelo and Zipfel.'
Jin inferred Sakiel's intention in a single moment. Of course, he couldn't be completely sure, but at the moment, he couldn't think of a better guess.
And Jin's hunch had never been wrong at moments like this.
{Leader, should we send some reinforcements to them?}
"No. We won't support them. Instead, we should press harder on the defense line we are responsible for."
{But what if they manage to break through to the hinterland? Especially if they break through Kinzelo, right behind them is the territory of the alliance.}

"Kinzelo might look like an easy target, but they're not weak. Not to mention Zipfel. Unless a demon of Genesis level appears, they won't be broken through easily. If the situation arises where the demons break through Kinzelo's fleet and attack the hinterland, all we have to do is send immediate support with Mort and Red Owl. Instead, we need to keep up with Kinzelo's situation in real-time."
{Ah, I see what you mean. I'll send the Nameless King.}
"That would be good."
Then Jin called Dante. As soon as Dante picked up the communicator, he said this.
{Jin, is it my turn to join the fight?}
"Yes, Red Owl will be leaving soon, so come to the battlefield. Our ancestors will fill your place."
